item.title: [Focus Features] WET HOT AMERICAN SUMMER - 25th Anniversary Release Official Trailer - Only in Theaters this August
item.description:
Wetter. Hotter. American-er. Wet Hot American Summer returns to theaters August 14!

Get Tickets Now: https://www.focusfeatures.com/wet-hot-american-summer

It's the last day of Camp Firewood's season, but there's still time for the big talent show, a little romance… and for everyone to be wiped out by the piece of NASA's Skylab that's hurtling toward Earth. Directed by David Wain and co-written by David Wain and Michael Showalter, WET HOT AMERICAN SUMMER is widely regarded as one of the most influential cult comedies of all time, introducing audiences to one of the most remarkable comedy ensembles of its generation, featuring Paul Rudd, Amy Poehler, Bradley Cooper, Elizabeth Banks, Molly Shannon, Christopher Meloni, Michael Ian Black, Janeane Garofalo, David Hyde Pierce, Ken Marino, Joe Lo Truglio and Michael Showalter.

item.title: [Focus Features] SENSE AND SENSIBILITY - Official Trailer [HD] - Only In Theaters October 16
item.description:
Based on Jane Austen's iconic masterpiece, watch the trailer for SENSE AND SENSIBILITY, starring Daisy Edgar-Jones, Esmé Creed-Miles, Caitríona Balfe, George MacKay, and Fiona Shaw. Only in theaters October 16.

From Focus Features and Working Title comes an irresistible new take on Jane Austen’s iconic Sense and Sensibility: a charming, witty, and deeply relatable story of love and sisterhood starring Daisy Edgar-Jones and Esmé Creed-Miles.
